wstep: There is no recipe here for tomatillos in wine vinegar: JarAtlas has no recipe for them from a checked source. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: A boiling-water bath is suitable only for acid foods, such as fruits, pickles, jams and fruit butters, and only with the research-based process times of the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning. [T:SZY-054]
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, vegetables and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions. [T:ACI-016]
Use only vinegar labelled 5% acidity; white and cider vinegar can be used interchangeably; do not use wine vinegars or homemade vinegar, and do not replace the vinegar with lemon juice. [T:ACI-509]

akapity: When canning plain tomatillos in water, NCHFP requires acidification, as for tomatoes. [T:ACI-060]
Without a tested recipe, there is no checked process time or vinegar proportion for tomatillos in wine vinegar. [T:-]
